submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
EDIT INPUT IMAGE 1 into ONE new combat animation pose of the SAME Ghost Script Calligrapher Boy (灵篆书生). Single full-body sprite, square canvas, genuine RGBA transparent background, highest polished hand-painted quality. No sheet, no labels.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE directional idle EDIT TARGET: keep its camera, face viewing angle, head/body scale, character identity, anatomical hand ownership and planted-foot baseline. Image 2 is PRIMARY APPROVED STYLE reference only (bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painting, delicate gold/jade/ivory textures); ignore its UI and other characters. Image 3 is identity/costume detail reference only, NOT its frontal view or pose.
IDENTITY LOCK: brown tousled short hair, high tied tuft with yin-yang jade/gold hairpiece and teal ribbon, teal diamond forehead mark; large head, short limbs; charcoal black short robe with warm-gold cloud embroidery and ivory lining, jade belt yin-yang clasp, black/gold shoes. ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand holds ONE large black-shaft calligraphy brush with jade/gold collars, white bristles tapering into dark ink point. ANATOMICAL LEFT hand holds ONE ivory BLANK hanging scroll with decorative cloud border, black/gold rods and yin-yang teal tassel. Exactly TWO separate pale-cyan ink spirits stay beside the scroll; never add extra droplets with faces, delete, merge or multiply spirits. Preserve all props through foreshortening. No text on scroll.
CANVAS LOCK: preserve image1 fixed full-body framing and relative head scale. Soles on the baseline about 92% of image height; only pose changes, camera does not rotate or zoom. Keep weapon, hair/ribbon, scroll and spirits safely inside canvas. Actual newly drawn pose, no image mirroring/duplication/warp/interpolation, no global translation to simulate recoil.
NO large spells, rays, circular aura, screen-flash, contact particles, shadow disk, ground, scene, UI, labels, checkerboard artwork or opaque backdrop.
POSE AND DIRECTION: Basic attack frame06 of12, maximum forward brush POINT-THRUST. Face and nose LEFT SIDE PROFILE, never frontal. Anatomical RIGHT hand extends its brush toward screen-LEFT at chest height, bristle tip points LEFT, rear brush end toward RIGHT; rotate naturally in right grip, never swap hands. Elbow nearly straight, torso leans forward8 degrees, front knee bent, rear foot grounded. Anatomical LEFT hand holds blank hanging scroll back close to hip, with two spirits. Determined eyes LEFT. No projectile or magic. Short attack in place, no running; after near-contact frame05 before followthrough07. Preserve complete brush within canvas. Independently draw WEST anatomy, not mirrored east.
